text:
Your Hakone ryokan includes dinner and check-in closes at 18:00. On a Wednesday in December, the train that gets you there calmly leaves Shinjuku at 15:00, not later. Here's how we worked it back 👇

💴 The price gap surprised us. Take a guess, then look 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-ryokan-dinner-leave-tokyo

🚃 A · GO STRAIGHT THERE

⏱️ The 15:00 Romancecar reaches Hakone-Yumoto at 16:25; the 16:27 mountain train climbs to Gora by 17:03. ¥2,871 by IC card, seat included.

📞 Our sample ryokan in Gora is about 850 m from the station, uphill. Its listing says: phone from Gora Station after 15:30 and they collect you in about 5 minutes.

⚠️ Miss it, and the 15:21 express (two changes) reaches Gora at 17:48. It works, with 12 minutes to spare.

🗿 B · ADD ONE STOP

🎟️ Take the 10:00 Romancecar instead and stop at the Hakone Open-Air Museum, one station before Gora. ¥2,000 at the door, ¥1,800 online.

⏰ Trains to Gora leave at 16:31, 16:47, 17:01, then not until 17:31. Leave the museum by 16:50.

🌙 C · LEAVING TOKYO LATE

🏨 Don't pay for a dinner you can't reach. A room-only hotel 150 m from Hakone-Yumoto Station was ¥16,800 for two on our date.

🔥 The 18:00 Romancecar arrives at 19:40, and a charcoal grill 2 minutes away takes last orders at 21:30 (closed Mondays).

✅ OUR TAKE

Ryokan dinner: be on the 15:00. Free morning: the 10:00 plus the museum. Stuck in Tokyo until evening: room only in Yumoto.
